# Radim Klaška

> Drupal backend developer, security and DevOps engineer from Teplice, Czech Republic. Building websites since 2004 and Drupal sites since 2007; at Morpht since 2014. Founding member and chairman of the Czech Drupal Association.

## Profile

- Work: Drupal backend developer & DevOps at [Morpht](https://www.morpht.com) (2014 to present). Coordinates security updates across all Morpht projects, keeps builds and tests running, and sets developers up with local environments (Lando). Before that: Drupal developer at PLAYzone (2011-2014), freelance Drupal site builder (2006-2011).
- Community: founding member and chairman of the [Czech Drupal Association](https://www.drupal.cz/assoc); organiser of Drupal Iron Camp and Drupal CS camp, volunteer at DrupalCons.
- Side quests: reverse engineering Onewheel boards (BMS firmware decompiled and documented), one of the few people repairing Onewheels in Europe.
- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Czech Technical University in Prague (2012).
- Languages: Czech (native), English (working professional).

## Services

- [Vaše IT oddělení](https://it.klaska.net/): external IT department for small businesses (Czech)
- [Malá stránka](https://malastranka.cz/): simple websites for small businesses (Czech)

Business ID (IČO) 88124444, not a VAT payer. Office: Cowosedlice.cz, Míru 218, 417 31 Novosedlice, Czech Republic.
